name: powercordkit
description: PowerCordKit — Discord mod tools suite + Unified Mod Inbox

scripts.db:migrate:local:community: wrangler d1 migrations apply powercordkit-mail-community --local --config wrangler.community.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote:community: wrangler d1 migrations apply powercordkit-mail-community --remote --config wrangler.community.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote:community:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply powercordkit-mail-community --remote --config wrangler.community.local.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:remote:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply powercordkit-mail --remote --config wrangler.local.jsonc
scripts.deploy:tools: npm run build:tools && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.tools.jsonc
scripts.deploy:tools:local: npm run build:tools && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.tools.local.jsonc
